info.name: SIT CSE Department & Institution Enterprise Portal API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman API Collection covering 100% of all 24 Spring Boot REST Controllers for SIT Pune CSE Department Portal.

Modules: Authentication, User Profile, Faculty Batches, Student Records & Verification, Parent Portal, Organization Hierarchy, Notices, In-App Notifications, Web Push Multi-Device Notifications, Training & Placement Hub, Courses, Laboratories, Research Labs, Academic Calendar Ingestion, Campus News & Events, Web Scraper, Discussion Forum Q&A, Document Center, Email Dispatcher, Analytics, Activity Logs, Security Audit Trail, System Settings, and Schedulers.
